description: Unsigned transactions taking what a version 2 trade account keeps for the wallet: a bailout payment the wallet could not take when it was made (USDG had the wallet frozen, or the token refused the transfer), kept in the token it was paid in: USDG, bUSDG shares, a short's held money as BorroShort's vault shares, or a stock vault's shares from a long's in-kind settlement. One claim for each token the account keeps something of (token: one of them), to the wallet or to `to`. Refused in words when the account keeps nothing for it; while USDG has the wallet frozen the claim waits too (PayeeFrozen). Simulated from the wallet.

to.description: Where it goes (default the wallet; neither the wallet nor to may be frozen by USDG)

token.description: USDG, bUSDG, held (BorroShort's vault shares), a stock's symbol (its vault's shares) or a token's address (default: every token kept for the wallet)

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: bailout_claim
title: Prepare: claim a payment a trade account keeps
